hooks.name: pre-tool-use
hooks.description: Before a shell, file write or iwe MCP tool: refuse a force push (KIRO_ALLOW_FORCE_PUSH=1), `iwe normalize` (IWE_ALLOW_NORMALIZE=1) and hand edits of generated files (KIRO_ALLOW_GENERATED_WRITE=1), the commands and .kiro/settings writes that docs/tooling/agent-permissions.md forbids; ask the user before a git command that discards uncommitted changes (docs/tooling/git-hooks.md).
